prompt: Write an email as the teaching assistant of the "Introduction to Computer Science" course, and tell the class that we will not be meeting this week.
response_text:
Here is a sample email:

---

**Subject: Class Cancelled This Week - Introduction to Computer Science**

Dear Students,

I hope this message finds you all doing well. I am writing to let you know that our **Introduction to Computer Science** class will **not be meeting this week**.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Please keep an eye on the course portal and your email for any updates regarding upcoming assignments, readings, or any changes to the schedule moving forward.

In the meantime, feel free to use this time to review any previous material, work on current assignments, or get ahead on any upcoming coursework. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to me by email and I will be happy to help.

We look forward to seeing you all next week. Thank you for your understanding!

Best regards,

**[Your Name]**
Teaching Assistant, Introduction to Computer Science
[University/Institution Name]
[Email Address]
[Office Hours/Contact Information]

---

Feel free to customize this email with any additional details, such as the reason for the cancellation or any specific instructions for the week.
